name: contract-generated-registry-canonical
goal: Reject generated projects with stale or noncanonical unit registries

evidence: Commit 5b280466ff emits a library registry that validates structurally but units check rejects as noncanonical: testing precedes neither budgets nor its own states.

The existing template case parsed the manifest and rendered its Example but never passed the full generated project through registry admission; the existing CLI case does, but its laptop run is still queued.
The existing template case rejects the generated entry.index as stale while the other four cases pass.
Emit fields in the declared schema order and retain the existing template case as a full generated-registry admission guard.
Emit the authored examples and budgets in registry schema order.
The same five cases pass at 9e63736d55; the generated registry now has no admission or staleness errors.
Isolated mutant a9aa17b860 restored the rejected ordering: capture e74889267a62 fails one case. Restored source 9e63736d55 passes all five in capture 4ee0a934b4fd.
